label: material for purchasing
means: supplier comparison or a ranked supplier view the customer's purchasing team can act on

label: farm and land target
means: a separate farm or land use target in a customer's letter to its suppliers

label: own data security and exit
means: the customer's own data: hosting; security; export and deletion on exit

label: deforestation tracing
means: origin tracing or deforestation risk sold or promised

label: mill and cooperative method
means: co product allocation or one number for a cooperative

label: cs candour
means: CSM honesty lines: renew for the right reason; tell the buyer before they ask

label: answer a customer's data request
means: a named customer asks for footprints or data by a date

label: commercial consequence behind the request
means: range review; on pack claim; keeping a key customer; answering first; an importer's needs

label: more people using the numbers
means: not being the only person; colleagues or brand buyers using the numbers

label: act through purchasing and owners
means: change how procurement buys; show owners which suppliers matter

label: protect supplier goodwill
means: keep farms and suppliers on side while asking for data

label: set targets
means: emissions or land targets the customer must set

label: pass an audit or verification
means: numbers that stand up to an auditor or verifier

label: bring purchasing along
means: material or help to take supplier numbers to the purchasing team

label: make the case to leadership
means: material to justify or explain the purchase to the MD or owners

label: read a customer's requirements
means: help understanding a customer's letter or target requirement

label: a second user
means: training or material so someone else can use the tool

label: supplier request know how
means: how to word or start a data request to suppliers

label: numbers change nothing
means: the data isn't leading to decisions

label: supplier screen
means: the supplier screen is unclear or sorted the wrong way

label: slow loading
means: slow views or time outs
